subject: general
question:
The given bar graph shows the production of drones (in lakhs) by three companies X, Y and Z over 6 years (from 2012 to 2017). Answer the question given below based on the bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2187e9fd11554d410b90aa91b7ab3d3673d767e2309b01354ed756fcec9a2941.png] 

What is the ratio of the average production of company X in the period 2014-2016 to the average production of company Y in the same period?
solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph shows the production of drones (in lakhs) by three companies X, Y and Z over 6 years (from 2012 to 2017).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2187e9fd11554d410b90aa91b7ab3d3673d767e2309b01354ed756fcec9a2941.png] 

**Calculations:**

Average production of Company X in period 2014-2016 

= (40 + 50 + 35)/3

= 125/3

Average production of Company Y in period 2014-2016 

= (45 + 45 + 55)/3

= 145/3

Required Ratio

= 125/3 : 145/3

= 125 : 145

= 25 : 29

**Hence, The Required ratio is 25 : 29**.
